title: Sports Trivia
description: Test your knowledge across the world of sports!

questions.question: How many players are on a soccer team on the field at one time?
questions.explanation: Each soccer team fields 11 players, including the goalkeeper.

questions.question: How often are the Summer Olympic Games held?
questions.explanation: The Summer Olympics are held every 4 years, alternating with the Winter Games every 2 years.

questions.question: A basketball hoop is 10 feet high.
questions.explanation: The standard NBA basketball rim height is exactly 10 feet (3.05 meters) from the floor.

questions.question: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cup titles?
questions.explanation: Brazil has won the World Cup 5 times (1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, 2002).

questions.question: In tennis, what is a score of zero called?
questions.explanation: In tennis scoring, zero is called 'love', possibly derived from the French 'l'oeuf' meaning egg.

questions.question: Michael Phelps holds the record for most Olympic gold medals.
questions.explanation: Michael Phelps won 23 Olympic gold medals, the most of any Olympian in history.

questions.question: How many points is a touchdown worth in American football?
questions.explanation: A touchdown is worth 6 points, with an extra point kick or 2-point conversion afterward.

questions.question: Which sport is played at Wimbledon?
questions.explanation: Wimbledon is the oldest and most prestigious tennis tournament, held annually in London.

questions.question: How many holes are played in a standard round of golf?
questions.explanation: A standard round of golf consists of 18 holes.

questions.question: A hat-trick in hockey or soccer means scoring three goals in one game.
questions.explanation: A hat-trick is achieved when a single player scores three goals in one match.
